description: Prevent recurrence of the reversed apartment 210 handle and backside camera errors. Add a narrowly scoped repo-local skill discoverable through AGENTS.md: register each changed component to context and detail evidence before coding; state a real-world viewing direction; verify handedness, host attachment, projection and estimated anchors; compare local renders against reference images before publishing; retain review evidence and do not call user feedback first-pass QA. Preserve lightweight capture and avoid exhaustive measurements. Extract existing world-space component focus into a testable helper and add meaningful nested-parent/occlusion regression tests. Validate skill, run required project checks, publish public workflow knowledge, verify deployment and close with review instructions.
